## About
From Scratch Renovation is a residential and commercial renovation company on Old 41 Hwy NW in Kennesaw. We believe in giving our clients the best quality construction and renovation work at a competitive price point.
We offer design build services. Our team includes a structural engineer and an interior designer. We take your ideas for your home, help fine tune them, create plans, get the project permitted and see it through. Our crews respect your home and property, and we keep you informed at every step.
Homeowners know us for that kind of care. One reviewer said Edson helped them make design decisions every step of the project. We hold a 4.7 rating from 37 Google reviews.

## Services
- Interior Renovation: Full service kitchen, bath and all types of interior renovations, built around your inspirations and ideas.
- Exterior Renovation: Everything from minor repairs to repainting, and from roofing to siding.
- Kitchen: Kitchen renovations, including new floors, with plumbing and HVAC work done as part of the project, as one reviewer described.
- Bathroom: Bathroom and master bathroom remodels, with help on design and tile choices along the way.
- Roofing: Roofing as part of our exterior renovation work.
- Siding: Siding and repainting to refresh the outside of your home.
- Design build services: Our team includes a structural engineer and an interior designer. We help fine tune your ideas, create plans, get the project permitted and complete it.

## FAQ
Q: How do I get started?
A: Call us for a free consult or request a quote. You can reach us at (404) 333-1440 or fromscratchrenovation@gmail.com.

Q: Do you take care of plans and permits?
A: Yes. We take your ideas, help fine tune them, create plans, get the project permitted and complete the work.

Q: Do you work on businesses as well as homes?
A: Yes. We do residential and commercial work, and your home or business is in good hands with our team.
